Gaussian_surrogate_extension.DGP: X~N_p(0,I),Y~Bernoulli(.5) independent. Z is Y flipped independently with probability epsilon; the frozen oracle g(Z)=epsilon+(1-2epsilon)Z is observed in labelled and auxiliary samples.
Gaussian_surrogate_extension.auxiliary_limit: Population imputed loss; finite-pool extension only in the stated N/p->infinity regime
Gaussian_surrogate_extension.candidate_exact_formula: Binomial disagreement count and conditional balanced labels yield a triple-binomial mixture of chi-square CDFs. Verify by direct X,Y,Z draws, and epsilon=.5 reduction to the previous exact formula.
Gaussian_surrogate_extension.candidate_boundary: kappa_c=1/[2*pi*epsilon*(1-epsilon)]. For the oracle, population variance-optimal lambda tends to1 as auxiliary/label ratio diverges.
Gaussian_surrogate_extension.claim_limits: No broad high-dimensional coverage theorem or novelty guarantee. Generic support geometry and PPI tuning remain attributed prior work.
